tools.name: list_open_opportunities
tools.description: List open, rolling and announced upcoming grants, programs and funding opportunities, soonest deadline first. Uses today's date; excludes expired and stale checks. Official pages are the authority.

tools.name: search_entries
tools.description: Search entries (terms, tools, organizations, investors, programs, schools, user groups, places) by name, alias or rough spelling. Returns the best matches with a one-line summary and the id to pass to get_entry.

tools.name: get_entry
tools.description: Get one entry by id: its definition, example, published funding evidence with source URLs, computed application status, eligibility and last check, official site, public connections and their sources, and its page URL.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the map's categories (topics) with how many entries each has and their ids for get_category.

tools.name: get_category
tools.description: List the entries in one category, Tulsa entries first, then by connections, with a one-line summary each.

tools.name: list_kinds
tools.description: List the kinds that have browse pages and their entry counts.

tools.name: get_kind
tools.description: List entries of one kind, Tulsa entries first, then by connections, with a one-line summary each.
